导出会把全部绑定与用到的素材打包成一个文件（署名与授权信息一同带走）；导入时自动: Export packs every binding and the assets it uses into a single file — credits and licensing info come along. Import checks the file and merges duplicates automatically; a broken file is never written.
按服务商或全局绑定：填「给谁用 / 服务商 / 模型 / 在哪个状态出现」，再选: Bind by provider or globally: fill in "target / provider / model / when it shows", then pick an asset. For a single card, assigning on the "Role Card" tab is quicker.
一条绑定＝「给谁用」＋「在哪个状态出现」（可以再限定只用在哪个画面），对应一张素: One binding = "who it's for" + "when it shows" (optionally limited to one surface), mapped to one asset. When several bindings match the same spot, the most specific wins. Bound by model: the same card on other channels counts as the same spot. Bound by form: the other models of that form share one set.
越具体的越优先：按模型 > 按卡（精确）> 按形态 > 按卡（代表）> 按服务商: Most specific wins: by model > by card (exact) > by form > by card (representative) > by provider > global default; within one binding, "state" beats "surface"
